title: AI Film Noir Generator
summary: Make film noir style images and video with AI. Describe the scene, pick a noir style, and Flick adds hard shadows, venetian blinds and rain-slick streets.
body_markdown:
### What is the film noir style?


The film noir style is the look of 1940s and 1950s Hollywood crime films: black and white images with hard, low-key light, deep shadows, venetian blind patterns, smoke, rain-slick streets and characters like detectives and femmes fatales.


### How do I make a film noir image with AI?


Describe the scene with one hard light and the shadows it throws, such as a detective at a desk lit by a single lamp with blind shadows on the wall, ask for black and white with film grain, pick a noir style, and generate.


### Is there a noir filter for photos and videos?


A noir filter that turns colour into black and white keeps the original flat light. For the real look, describe the scene in Flick with noir lighting so the image is generated with hard shadows from the start.


### What is neo-noir?


Neo-noir is the later, colour version of film noir: the same crime stories, hard shadows and night streets, but with saturated colour such as teal and red neon, rain-soaked reflections and a modern setting.


### Can I make a film noir video, not just an image?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, and describe slow motion that suits noir, such as smoke rising, rain on the window or a figure walking out of the light.


### Is the film noir generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
